How to Order

Four simple steps — most gifts are ready in 2–3 days.

  1. 1Pick your gift — choose a frame size or any photo gift above.
  2. 2Send your photo on WhatsApp — tap “Order on WhatsApp”; the gift name and price are already in the message. Send your photo in the same chat.
  3. 3Pay with GPay — scan the QR below or pay to our UPI ID. We confirm your order on WhatsApp.
  4. 4We design, make & deliver — collect at the studio, or we courier it to your address (courier charges extra).
